article_content: UK authorities are implementing revised security protocols for individuals under terrorism-related restrictions, focusing on designated places of worship. The Home Office will identify specific religious institutions where monitored persons are prohibited from attending, responding to security breaches including a recent incident where a suspect evaded surveillance after departing a London mosque wearing traditional attire. Those subject to Terrorism Prevention and Investigation Measures (TPIMs) now face enhanced constraints including regulated access to religious facilities and potential relocation within their current city of residence. Updated protocols mandate increased police reporting frequency and extended overnight confinement periods up to the legal maximum of 10 hours for high-risk cases. Official records indicate seven individuals have circumvented counter-terrorism monitoring since 2015, with multiple suspects believed to have joined extremist groups overseas. Security analysts critique current policies, particularly the 2012 decision limiting relocation authority which some experts argue facilitates evasion attempts. Legal commentators note that previous counter-terrorism frameworks permitted broader geographical relocation, potentially enhancing monitoring effectiveness. The Home Secretary has instructed security agencies to fully utilize existing surveillance powers while acknowledging the inherent challenges of non-custodial observation systems.
translated_content: Pihak berkuasa UK memperkenalkan protokol keselamatan baharu untuk individu bawah sekatan berkaitan keganasan, khususnya di tempat ibadah tertentu. Kementerian Dalam Negeri akan senaraikan masjid yang dilarang dikunjungi suspek, ekoran insiden keselamatan termasuk kes terbaru di mana seorang suspek melarikan diri dari masjid London dengan menyamar memakai burqa. Individu bawah Langkah Pencegahan dan Siasatan Keganasan (TPIM) kini hadapi sekatan lebih ketat: akses terhad ke masjid dan mungkin dipindah dalam bandar sama. Peraturan baharu wajibkan mereka lapor lebih kerap ke balai polis dan dikurung malam sehingga 10 jam bagi kes berisiko tinggi. Rekod rasmi menunjukkan tujuh suspek berjaya elak pemantauan sejak 2015, dengan beberapa dipercayai menyertai kumpulan ekstremis luar negara. Pakar keselamatan kritik dasar TPIM 2012 yang hadkan kuasa pindah suspek ke bandar lain - faktor yang dikatakan memudahkan pelarian. Pemerhati undang-undang nyatakan sistem sebelum 2012 benarkan pindah suspek ke lokasi lain di seluruh negara, mungkin lebih berkesan. Menteri Dalam Negeri arahkan agensi gunakan sepenuhnya kuasa sedia ada, sambil akui cabaran dalam sistem pemantauan bukan tahanan.

article_content: An ancient Buddhist temple step, once used as a doorstep in Exeter, UK, sold for £553,250 at auction on 23-24 April 2013—over 10 times its £30,000–£50,000 estimate. The 1,300-year-old granite relic, carved with symbols of lions, horses, elephants, and birds, originated from Sri Lanka's Anuradhapura period (400 BC–1017 AD). Owner Bronwen Hickmott inherited the 2.4-meter-long stone from her parents, who received it from a tea planter in the 1950s. Initially dismissed by Sotheby's and BBC's Antiques Roadshow, the artifact's value was later confirmed by Bonhams' experts. Anuradhapura, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is among the oldest continuously inhabited cities. The temple step is among the few surviving examples from this era. Hickmott described the sale as 'a Pretty Woman moment' for those who initially overlooked the artifact.
translated_content: Sebuah tangga kuil Buddha kuno yang pernah dijadikan alas pintu di Exeter, UK, berjaya dijual dengan harga £553,250 (RM3.1 juta) dalam satu lelongan pada 23–24 April 2013—melebihi 10 kali anggaran asal £30,000–£50,000. Relik granit berusia 1,300 tahun ini, diukir dengan motif singa, kuda, gajah, dan burung, berasal dari zaman Kerajaan Anuradhapura di Sri Lanka (400 SM–1017 TM). Bronwen Hickmott, pemiliknya, mewarisi batu sepanjang 2.4 meter ini daripada ibu bapanya yang menerimanya daripada seorang penanam teh pada 1950-an. Walaupun awalnya dipandang remeh oleh Sotheby's dan program Antiques Roadshow BBC, nilai sebenar artifak ini akhirnya disahkan pakar lelongan Bonhams. Anuradhapura, yang diiktiraf sebagai Tapak Warisan Dunia UNESCO, antara bandar tertua yang masih didiami. Tangga kuil ini merupakan salah satu daripada sedikit tinggalan sejarah era tersebut yang masih wujud. Hickmott menyifatkan kejadian ini sebagai 'detik Pretty Woman' buat pihak yang awalnya mengabaikan nilai relik tersebut.

article_content: SAN FRANCISCO, Calif. – A low-speed collision between two Muni light rail cars at West Portal Station on Saturday resulted in 44 injuries, none life-threatening. Officials confirmed a moving train struck a stationary unit, with preliminary investigation suggesting a conductor's turning error. San Francisco General Hospital's Leslie Dubbin reported all patients in stable condition. Muni spokesperson Judson True stated service remains suspended through the station, with shuttle buses deployed for K/T, L, and M lines. No timeline exists for normal service resumption.
translated_content: SAN FRANCISCO, Calif. – Dua gerabak tren ringan Muni berlanggar secara perlahan di Stesen West Portal pada Sabtu, mengakibatkan 44 kes kecederaan tanpa mengancam nyawa. Pihak berkuasa mengesahkan tren bergerak melanggar tren berhenti, dengan siasatan awal menunjukkan kesilapan ketika membelok oleh pengendali. Leslie Dubbin dari Hospital Umum San Francisco melaporkan semua pesakit stabil. Jurucakap Muni Judson True memaklumkan perkhidmatan masih ditangguhkan di stesen berkenaan, dengan bas pengganti beroperasi untuk laluan K/T, L dan M. Tiada tempoh pemulihan perkhidmatan biasa diberikan setakat ini.
